\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{শতাংশ} (shôtāngshô)}{শতাংশ (shôtāngshô)}]{\bn{শতাংশ} (shôtāngshô) — a percentage; per cent}

\label{lesson:BN-C356-shotangsho}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to collect, then the Bengali for to analyse.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{শতাংশ}}
\textbf{\bn{শতাংশ}} — \emph{shôtāngshô} — \textquotedblleft{}a percentage; per cent\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{ছাত্রদের} \bn{পঞ্চাশ} \bn{শতাংশ} \bn{পাস} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{chhātrôder pônchāsh shôtāngshô pās kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Fifty per cent of the students passed.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{শতাংশ}} (\emph{shôtāngshô}) is Sanskrit \emph{śata}, a hundred, with \emph{aṃśa}, a share (Monier-Williams): a share out of a hundred.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shôtāngshô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shôtāngshô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chhātrôder pônchāsh shôtāngshô pās kôrlô.} — Fifty per cent of the students passed.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to collect, then the Bengali for to analyse, then say \emph{shôtāngshô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{শতাংশ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A percentage; per cent\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অনুপাত} (ônupāt)}{অনুপাত (ônupāt)}]{\bn{অনুপাত} (ônupāt) — a ratio; a proportion}

\label{lesson:BN-C356-onupat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to analyse, then the Bengali for a percentage.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অনুপাত}}
\textbf{\bn{অনুপাত}} — \emph{ônupāt} — \textquotedblleft{}a ratio; a proportion\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{ছেলে} \bn{আর} \bn{মেয়ের} \bn{অনুপাত} \bn{সমান।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{chhele ār meyer ônupāt sômān.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The ratio of boys to girls is even.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অনুপাত}} (\emph{ônupāt}) is Sanskrit \emph{anupāta}, proportion in arithmetic (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{হিসেব} \bn{করা} (hiseb kôrā)}{হিসেব করা (hiseb kôrā)}]{\bn{হিসেব} \bn{করা} (hiseb kôrā) — to calculate; to work out}

\label{lesson:BN-C356-hiseb-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a percentage, then the Bengali for a ratio.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{হিসেব} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{হিসেব} \bn{করা}} — \emph{hiseb kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to calculate; to work out\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমি} \bn{খরচটা} \bn{হিসেব} \bn{করলাম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āmi khôrôchṭā hiseb kôrlām.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I worked out the cost.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{সব} \bn{খরচ} \bn{হিসেব} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini sôb khôrôch hiseb kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{হিসেব} \bn{করা}} (\emph{hiseb kôrā}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{ḥisāb}, reckoning, through Persian, in its spoken Bengali form \bn{হিসেব}, with \bn{করা}.
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{মাপকাঠি} (māpkāṭhi)}{মাপকাঠি (māpkāṭhi)}]{\bn{মাপকাঠি} (māpkāṭhi) — a yardstick; a standard}

\label{lesson:BN-C356-mapkathi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a ratio, then the Bengali for to calculate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{মাপকাঠি}}
\textbf{\bn{মাপকাঠি}} — \emph{māpkāṭhi} — \textquotedblleft{}a yardstick; a standard\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সাফল্যের} \bn{মাপকাঠি} \bn{কী}?
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sāphôlyer māpkāṭhi kī?}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
What is the yardstick of success?
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{মাপকাঠি}} (\emph{māpkāṭhi}) is \bn{মাপ}, a measure (CDIAL 10053 lists Bengali māp), with \bn{কাঠি}, a stick (CDIAL 3120 \emph{kāṣṭhá}, wood, lists Bengali kāṭhī as a slim bamboo rod for measuring): a measuring stick, and so a standard to judge by.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māpkāṭhi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sāphôlyer māpkāṭhi kī?} — What is the yardstick of success?
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a ratio, then the Bengali for to calculate, then say \emph{māpkāṭhi} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{মূল্যায়ন} \bn{করা} (mūlyāyôn kôrā)}{মূল্যায়ন করা (mūlyāyôn kôrā)}]{\bn{মূল্যায়ন} \bn{করা} (mūlyāyôn kôrā) — to evaluate; to assess}

\label{lesson:BN-C356-mulyayon-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to calculate, then the Bengali for a yardstick.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{মূল্যায়ন} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{মূল্যায়ন} \bn{করা}} — \emph{mūlyāyôn kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to evaluate; to assess\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{বিচারকরা} \bn{প্রতিযোগিতার} \bn{ছবিগুলো} \bn{মূল্যায়ন} \bn{করলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{bichārôkrā prôtijogitār chhôbigulo mūlyāyôn kôrlen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The judges assessed the pictures in the competition.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{আমার} \bn{কাজ} \bn{মূল্যায়ন} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini āmār kāj mūlyāyôn kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{মূল্যায়ন} \bn{করা}} (\emph{mūlyāyôn kôrā}) is a modern Bengali formation on Sanskrit \emph{mūlya}, value (Monier-Williams), with \bn{করা}: to put a value on work or a result.
\end{cousinweb}
